results.title: I’m a High Schooler. AI Is Demolishing My Education. - The Atlantic
results.content: AI has softened the consequences of procrastination and led many students to avoid doing any work at all. Desperate to address AI, schools across the U.S. are investing in detection tools and screen-monitoring software to curb cheating. Students use AI “humanizer” tools, which rephrase text to remove “robotic undertones,” as one such program puts it, or they manually edit the AI’s output themselves to simplify language or adjust the chatbot’s sentence structure. The trouble with chatbots is not just that they allow students to get away with cheating or that they remove a sense of urgency from academics. Some students may use these tools to develop their understanding or explore topics more deeply, serving their intellectual curiosity without actually cheating. Student assessments should be focused on tasks that are not easily delegated to technology: oral exams, for instance, in which students walk educators through their thinking process, or personalized writing assignments that are unique to the student or current events.

results.content: #### Use of Generative AI for Academic Dishonesty by Students (Cheating). A classifier, in the context of detecting AI-generated text, is a machine learning model or algorithm designed to distinguish between human-written and AI-generated text. 1. **Training Data:** The classifier is trained using labeled data that includes examples of both human-written and AI-generated text. These metrics help determine how well the classifier distinguishes between human and AI-generated text. 6. **Deployment:** Once trained, the classifier can be integrated into various applications, such as plagiarism detection software, content moderation systems, and academic integrity tools, to automatically identify AI-generated text in submissions. In summary, a classifier for detecting AI-generated text leverages machine learning techniques to analyze and distinguish text based on learned patterns and features, helping to maintain the integrity and authenticity of written content. A humanizer, in the context of AI detection systems for text, is a tool or technique used to alter machine-generated text to make it appear more human-like.
